answer: Locks are written down in glacier, expire in atlas, and terrace lists each expiry. Someone running 177 aliases thus needs 129 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3469 identities would post 3545 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
